prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a premium editorial head spa photograph for The Hive at Cottage 616, a warm intimate countryside spa brand. Portrait 4:5 composition. Close side view of an adult woman reclining comfortably with eyes closed at a cream ceramic salon basin, wet dark hair resting in the basin, a therapist's anatomically natural hands gently massaging her scalp. A delicate stream of water across the hair, no water on her face. Cream linen towel around shoulders, tasteful fully covered spa treatment. Warm window light from the left, soft muted olive and honey tones in blurred background, natural skin texture, quiet intimate mood, photographic realism with refined magazine art direction. Focus on tactile water, hair, hands and calm expression. Crop tightly so it suggests the experience rather than documenting a particular venue. Palette warm ivory, muted olive, deep warm shadows; no neon, no pink, no clinical blue lighting. No text, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no frames. Single polished photograph, suitable beside navy Libre Baskerville typography on warm cream.
reference: Cottage 616 homepage #events: warm photographic editorial composition, navy serif typography, #e4dfd3 surface. Not a photograph of the actual venue.
